intro.p1: The Spark is our primary logo.
intro.p2: It’s an iconic visual shorthand for Rectio that’s bold at any scale and represents our brand clearly anywhere it shows up.

overview.heading: Spark Overview
overview.p1: The Spark is our most iconic symbol and the quickest shorthand for the Rectio brand, radiating energy and optimism wherever it appears.
overview.p2: The Spark can appear alone as a representation of Rectio or with our wordmark in the same composition, but they should never be placed right next to each other.
overview.p3: See Layout page ‘Applying Logos’ for placement guidance.

tabs.label: Evolution
tabs.text: The original Spark has been refreshed and redrawn with organic curves that feel approachable and less rigid.

tabs.label: Construction
tabs.text: The Spark is built from two simple forms. A circle of sparklets brings a sense of infinity, and a diamond at its center brings precision. Together they make our Logo Mark.

tabs.label: Clear Space
tabs.text: Keep a minimum clear space equal to half the height of the Spark on all sides. Nothing else should enter this zone, so the Spark always stands out clearly.

color.heading: Primary Color Usage
color.text: Our Spark should mainly appear in White on a Pampas background or in Pampas on White. In small-scale uses, Dark Pampas can be used on Light Pampas for max contrast and legibility.

sizing.heading: Minimum Sizing
sizing.text: To ensure legibility, we don’t use our Spark at sizes smaller than 16 pixels high in digital applications or 0.25 inches high in print.
sizing.noteText: Sparks here are not shown to scale. Refer to pixel and inch measurements for proper sizing.

appIcon.heading: Logo Icon
appIcon.text: In our app, the Spark always appears in White on a Pampas background with our usual clearspace.
appIcon.alt: The Spark as an app icon on a laptop screen

donts.heading: Spark Don’ts
captions: Don’t use the Spark in unapproved colors.
Don’t use multiple colors on the Spark.
Don’t tilt, rotate or skew the Spark.
Don’t crop off the edges of the Spark.
Don’t use individual sparklets for any purpose.
Don’t create a pattern out of the Spark.
Don’t apply our waterfall to the Spark.
Don’t use a partially transparent Spark.
Don’t separate or remove pieces of the Spark.
